passages.provision_quote: A male, based on a student's biological sex at birth in accordance with the student's genetics and reproductive biology, may not participate on an athletic team or sport designated under this section as being a female, women's, or girls' athletic team or sport.
passages.note: Enrolled act text; single-subject bill whose operative section sets eligibility by biological sex at birth.
King is in the Yea list on the veto override; 28 of 95 voting were Nay, so not near-unanimous.
passages.tally_quote: Yea 67 Participation in school sports. (2022) Nay 28 Excused 5 Not Voting 0

passages.note: Official bill page naming King as a co-author of the bill as filed.
passages.actor_quote: Co-Authored by: Rep. Chris Jeter, Rep. Joanna King, Rep. Robert Heaton.

rows.reasoning: King co-authored HB 1041 (2022) and voted Yea on the May 24, 2022 veto override of it, a single-subject bill whose operative section provides that "A male, based on a student's biological sex at birth in accordance with the student's genetics and reproductive biology, may not participate on an athletic team or sport designated under this section as being a female, women's, or girls' athletic team or sport." That is the rung requiring transgender athletes to compete only on teams matching their biological sex assigned at birth. The rung that would completely ban all transgender athletes from competing in any organized sports competitions is excluded by the bill's own text, which restricts only female-designated teams.
